text: My first visit was very impressive. I'm terrified of dentists; I always choke on the water and the suction device when I go to the dentist, so I always let go, afraid of getting scolded ;-; But the dentist was very kind and patient. I really liked this place. The dentist was gentle, friendly, and funny too. I loved it!

text: Today I had a walk-in tooth extraction. The female dentist was very gentle; the anesthetic injection was painless. After the molar extraction, the pain was minimal. The extraction fee was less than most private clinics.
